subject.title: fix(talk): diagnose invalid OpenAI realtime auth

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support `OPENCLAW_OPENAI_REALTIME_ALLOW_UNVALIDATED_KEY` as a public bypass for the new direct-OpenAI Realtime key classifier?
rationale: This is a new user-facing environment contract on an authentication path; repository policy sets a high bar for new configuration or environment surfaces, and the code cannot determine whether maintainers prefer a narrower classifier or an escape hatch.

options.title: Remove the bypass and narrow classification
options.body: Keep only high-confidence Azure/proxy detection and let unusual direct keys reach the existing provider request path.

options.title: Accept the bypass as supported contract
options.body: Retain the environment variable with explicit support, upgrade, and regression-test commitments for this auth override.

options.title: Pause pending auth-owner direction
options.body: Hold the branch until an OpenAI/plugin owner decides the permanent compatibility policy for unusual Platform key formats.

recommendation.title: Remove the bypass and narrow classification
recommendation.body: Keep only high-confidence Azure/proxy detection and let unusual direct keys reach the existing provider request path.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current bundled OpenAI Realtime provider and must choose the durable authentication contract.
